label: end of long inputs: <DEL> step and late original tokens (L>=6)
explanation: Fires only at the end of the input phase of long sequences: the <DEL> step (60% of mass, rate 36%) and original-phase steps t>=6 (40% of mass). Rate rises steeply with L (L=9 has 47% of mass, L<=5 almost none) and with position (orig_idx 8 fires 42%). Essentially never fires in the copy phase or at t<=3. Within that window it is content-dependent: higher for inputs m, h, 0, 1, j and for first-occurrence tokens, and higher when the first original token is w, k, 2, q, g or a; lower for inputs like i, f, b. That token weighting looks graded rather than a clean rule, so precision is limited (~0.54). Top activations (~0.2) are at <DEL> or the last 1-2 original tokens of L=8-9 sequences.
